strongest_angle: An October 2026 study led by the Instituto de Astrofísica de Canarias measured the colossal galaxy IC 1101 using ultra-deep imaging, providing precise constraints on the physical size limits of the most extended known galaxy in the Universe.

key_facts.fact: The Instituto de Astrofísica de Canarias published a study on October 2, 2026, measuring the size of the largest known galaxy, IC 1101.
Astronomers Carlos Marrero-de la Rosa, Ignacio Trujillo, Ignacio Ruiz Cejudo, Mireia Montes, and Fernando Buitrago authored the Astronomy & Astrophysics paper on IC 1101 published on October 1, 2026.
The Instituto de Astrofísica de Canarias press release on October 2, 2026 credits C. Marrero-de la Rosa et al. for the ultra-deep imaging study of IC 1101.
